verdicts.reason: A is basically a shrunken copy of the square. The ingredient-pill text and the logo wordmark are only a few pixels tall, the can is too small to anchor the layout, the gap between the two pill rows is wider than the gap from the headline, and there is a lot of empty space above and below. Still, the reading order and hierarchy hold up. B breaks the design: the 'Build Your Mix' CTA is shrunk to the size of a pill and jammed into a cramped top-left cluster with the ingredient pills, the legal line is moved up directly under the headline, and the reading order is scrambled (CTA before headline, product last). The bottom third is also left empty.
